title: Product
description: A product page — presentation-grade commerce fields plus optional slots for editorial content. Deliberately a brochure, not a catalogue: no variants, no inventory, no pricing rules (ADR-0018). A field belongs here only if a real PIM would overwrite it; a field a PIM would have to be reconciled with — a category taxonomy, a variant graph, a product-type schema — does not.

deliveryKeys.title: Delivery keys
deliveryKeys.description: Variant delivery keys for this item. Use the {site}/products/{slug} convention (ADR-0014) — e.g. acme/products/aurora-lounge-chair.

values.title: URL
values.description: Serve the product at this URL

value.description:
Use the format {siteKey}/products/{slug}
(e.g. acme site would have acme/products/aurora-lounge-chair)
value.title: Delivery Key

title.description: Product page title — <title> and SEO. Falls back to the product name when unset.

social.description: Open Graph overrides. Unset fields fall back to the product's own name and description.

canonicalUrl.description: Rarely set — when absent, the canonical defaults to the product's /products/{slug} path.

sku.title: SKU
sku.description: The product's identifier in your commerce or PIM system. Nothing renders it today — it is the join key to a PIM record or a search index later, and backfilling it across authored content is far more expensive than typing it now.

price.title: Price
price.description: Display only — this is not a pricing engine. No tax, no promotions, no currency conversion; a product shows the one price authored here.

currencyCode.title: Currency
currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. GBP, USD, EUR.

shortDescription.title: Short Description
shortDescription.description: A sentence or two shown on the product page and in cards. Longer copy belongs in the Content tab.

value.title: Short Description
value.description: A sentence or two shown on the product page and in cards.

status.title: Status
status.description: Editorial lifecycle, not stock. Availability is owned by your commerce system and changes by the hour; what the CMS knows is whether this page is live, teasing, or retired.

images.title: Images
images.description: Product imagery. The first image is the primary one — used on cards and as the lead image on the product page. Add more to turn the product page's image area into a gallery; one image renders as a single image, and none renders nothing at all.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Display-only spec rows — label and value, rendered as a definition list. Not a typed attribute system; a PIM owns that.

category.title: Category
category.description: Free-text category label (e.g. "Seating", "Tables"). Deliberately not a managed taxonomy — a real PIM owns that, and two taxonomies would have to be reconciled rather than simply replaced.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Topic tags — used for filtering and display.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: Ordered slots composing editorial content below the product detail — same pattern as Page and Blog Article. Optional: a product with none renders just its commerce fields.
